items.hook: The PowerBook Duo is a line of subnotebook computers introduced by Apple Computer in 1992 and sold until 1997.
items.body: Designed as a smaller companion to the PowerBook 100 series and the later 500 series, the line comprised seven models: the PowerBook Duo 210, 230, 250, 270c, 280, 280c, and 2300c. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.
